items.title: Jasper Taylor Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: Yes, uh, Armand, uh, P.R.E.S. T.O. on clarinet, and Eddie Adkins on trombone.

ctx.x: Do you remember who else was in the band? Any of the other fellows?
Yes, uh, Armand, uh, P.R.E.S. T.O. on clarinet, and Eddie Adkins on trombone. And, uh, what's the drummer's name? You know about that, huh?
Is it old man Contrell, they call him?
